messages.text: Jones warns England: You were good vs Japan, but All Blacks will be 'violent'

metadata.summary: Former England head coach Eddie Jones praised his old side as "very good" as they tore his Japan apart 78-15 on Saturday, but warned the All Blacks will be "violent" against them next week.
metadata.content: Eddie Jones warns England: You were very good against my Japan, but All Blacks will be 'violent' next week after Wales loss | Rugby Union News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Eddie Jones warns England: You were very good against my Japan, but All Blacks will be 'violent' next week after Wales loss Eddie Jones warns England the All Blacks will be 'violent' at Twickenham next week; Will Joseph scored five as England registered 13 tries in huge Nations Championship victory, with Jones' Japan alarmingly inferior; Steve Borthwick admits he now has 'thinking' to do around selection Michael Cantillon Sports Journalist Saturday 14 November 2026 20:41, UK Image: Former England head coach Eddie Jones threw a warning their way ahead of the All Blacks visiting Twickenham next week Former England head coach Eddie Jones praised his old side as "very good" as they tore his Japan apart 78-15 on Saturday, but warned the All Blacks will be "violent" against them next week. Following South Africa's defeat to France in Paris on Friday, victory for New Zealand against Wales in Cardiff would have seen them claim World Rugby's No 1 ranking, and take charge of the Nations Championship southern hemisphere table. Instead, the All Blacks suffered their first defeat to Wales since 1953 in a shock 35-28 loss up against an immense Welsh defensive effort, and next play England at Twickenham next Saturday. messages.text: Wales beaten in Norway as threat of Nations League relegation grows

metadata.summary: Wales suffered a 3-1 defeat to Norway in Oslo despite a spirited performance, as the threat of relegation to the second tier of the Nations League now looms over Craig Bellamy's side.

messages.text: Meetmebythesea gives McManus a first Paddy Power Gold Cup

metadata.summary: Ben Pauling’s Meetmebythesea showed his liking for Cheltenham once more and delivered owner JP McManus with his first victory in the prestigious Paddy Power Gold Cup.

messages.text: Devlin nets first international goal as Northern Ireland beat Ukraine

metadata.summary: Terry Devlin's first international goal kept Northern Ireland top of their Nations League group as a 1-0 win over Ukraine set up a promotion decider away to Hungary on Tuesday.

messages.text: Kalajdzic scores late as Republic of Ireland taste defeat in Austria

metadata.summary: Sasa Kalajdzic dealt the Republic of Ireland a late blow in Linz with the only goal in Austria's 1-0 Nations League victory at the Raiffeisen Arena.
